header.title: Transfer between applications
header.subtitle: Copy a timeline from one editing application to another, frame accurate.

form.richAeHint: Rebuilds transforms, speed and precomps instead of copying the shots over. Media is set below.
form.upscaleForcesReencode: Upscaling replaces pixels: Re-encode applies whatever is picked above.

preview.animationUnavailable: Keyframes unreadable: the source application refused the export that carries them. The transfer will place fixed values.
preview.mediaLess_one: {{count}} item without media (matte, adjustment layer): no application can receive it.
preview.mediaLess_other: {{count}} items without media (matte, adjustment layer): no application can receive them.
preview.graphics_one: {{count}} title: rebuilt on the target from its text and style.
preview.graphics_other: {{count}} titles: rebuilt on the target from their text and style.
preview.graphicsUnsupported_one: {{count}} title: the target cannot rebuild it, it will not be transferred.
preview.graphicsUnsupported_other: {{count}} titles: the target cannot rebuild them, they will not be transferred.

result.animatedNone: No keyframes read: DaVinci Resolve exposes none through scripting, only its XML export carries them.
result.tracksClamped: Tracks clamped: the target application could not create enough of them.
result.vehicleImport: Edit read by DaVinci Resolve: keyframes, audio levels and speed applied by the application itself.
result.vehicleApi: Shots placed one by one by script: keyframes come from what NetsuRush read.
result.exchangeFile: DaVinci Resolve refused the edit via scripting. The same file imports correctly by hand — keyframes and audio levels included: File ▸ Import ▸ Timeline.
result.containerFallback_one: {{count}} file written as MOV: MP4 carries neither ProRes, DNxHR nor PCM.
result.containerFallback_other: {{count}} files written as MOV: MP4 carries neither ProRes, DNxHR nor PCM.
result.mediaLess_one: {{count}} item without media (matte, adjustment layer): no application can receive it.
result.mediaLess_other: {{count}} items without media (matte, adjustment layer): no application can receive them.
result.titlesRetimed_one: {{count}} title kept the template duration: DaVinci Resolve offers no way to set it.
result.titlesRetimed_other: {{count}} titles kept the template duration: DaVinci Resolve offers no way to set it.

copy.label: Direct links
copy.hint: Original files linked as they are. No file written.

remux.label: Remux
remux.hint: New container, lossless. Useful when the target cannot read the source one.

reencode.label: Re-encode
reencode.hint: Every shot transcoded to an editing codec, cut to the exact frame.
